title: Verify immediate availability update on user action
gherkin:
Feature: Immediate availability synchronization
  Scenario: User updates availability status
    Given the user is logged in
    When the user changes their availability to 'Available'
    Then the system should immediately reflect the availability status as 'Available' across all platforms
rationale: To ensure that when a user updates their availability, the change is reflected in real-time, confirming the synchronization functionality.
generationSummary: Test cases for the requirement of immediate availability synchronization to ensure that the system updates availability in real-time across all relevant components.
